description: The full-screen board with the lighter tan floor of the owner's reference.
source_note: The Shop still of the board arena with the lighter floor tile (owner 2026-10-02, GDD §14 #71-#72, ADR-0024): res://scenes/arenas/board_01_light.tscn rendered by tools/godot/render_arena_still.gd at 941x1672 with no safe top and an empty HUD. floor_rect_note: The floor inside the frame as the scene drew it in the still (BoardArenaVisual.fit returns it: 62.7, 111.5 to 878.3, 1587.5), rounded to whole pixels, [left, top, right, bottom].
